interface.title: Trill View (TrillView + Spec View)
interface.field: Bioacoustics / ecology – interpreting deep-learning bird species classifiers
interface.stage_of_work: Model evaluation and label curation after running a classifier on field recordings
interface.what_it_is_for: Explore a radial scatterplot of a sound classifier's per-frame species confidence, inspect and listen to individual frames, select groups of frames, then page through their spectrograms to relabel them and save the corrected labels.

data.note: Uploaded example_fig.csv on TrillView. It held 2 true-label groups (Certhia americana, Poecile atricapillus) plus a '-' group of green class-anchor points on the outer arc, each shown as '<class> 100.0% - nan - nan'. Hover tooltips read 'actual label - predicted label score% - recording - start-end s', e.g. 'Poecile atricapillus - Setophaga petechia 38.3%'. Audio came from the server's example sounds. Spec View read the frames saved on the server (11 frames).

features.name: Scatterplot with hover signal preview and click-to-play
features.general: Hover a point in a scatterplot to see an image of the underlying signal and its true vs. predicted label; click to play the signal and pin its details
features.specific: Hover a TrillView marker to get a mel/STFT spectrogram tooltip with actual label, predicted species and score, recording and time; click to play the audio frame and show a 'Last clicked' line. The hover can pick a nearby marker instead of the one under the pointer (screens/009.webp, screens/011.webp)
steps: Load the prediction CSV
Choose spectrogram type (mel/STFT) and n_fft
Hover a marker to see its spectrogram and label/score
Click the marker to play its audio; the 'Last clicked' readout keeps its details
serves_tasks: Hover over a point to see a preview of the underlying signal and its true vs. predicted label
Click a point to play its audio and pin its details
Change how the signal preview is computed

features.name: Radial confidence plot with class legend filtering
features.general: Place each item at the confidence-weighted mix of class anchor positions, so its distance from its own class anchor shows how confident the classifier is and its pull toward other anchors shows likely confusions; hide or isolate classes to compare them
features.specific: Radial distribution plot where each frame's position is the softmax-weighted mix of the green class-anchor points on the arc: confident frames sit near their species' anchor, uncertain ones toward the centre. Click a legend species to hide it, double-click to isolate it (axes rescale), zoom into arms, reset axes
steps: Read where points lie relative to the class anchors (high confidence near an anchor, uncertain toward the centre, misclassified near another class's anchor)
Click a legend entry to hide that class
Double-click a legend entry to isolate a class
Zoom into a region and reset axes
serves_tasks: Read where items sit relative to their class anchor to judge each class's confidence and spot misclassified or outlying items
Show or hide groups to compare classes
Zoom into a dense region of the plot

features.name: Region selection to save a subset
features.general: Draw a box on a scatterplot to select points, see a live count, and add them to a saved subset file over repeated saves
features.specific: Use Box Select in TrillView (Lasso Select is offered but did not select anything in this run); the button changes to 'Save to csv N markers selected'; saving writes the frames (minus class anchors) to the server CSV, and later saves add 'additional' frames
steps: Pick the Box Select tool
Drag over a cluster; the button shows how many markers are selected
Press Save to csv; a status line confirms how many frames were saved
Select another region and save again to add to the subset
serves_tasks: Draw a region on the plot to select a group of points
Save the selected points to a subset file

features.name: Paged spectrogram card grid with inline relabelling
features.general: Review a saved subset as a paged grid of signal cards, each with playback, metadata and an editable label, then save the corrected labels
features.specific: Spec View cards show a dB-coloured spectrogram with a t/f/dB hover readout, an audio player, recording and time span; click the label, ✎ or spectrogram to edit, confirm with ✓ or Enter or cancel with ✕; Save labels to CSV writes labelled_frames.csv
steps: Open the saved subset (total saved frames shown)
Play a card's audio and hover the spectrogram for time/frequency/dB
Click the label, ✎ or spectrogram, type a new label, then ✓/Enter (or ✕ to cancel)
Repeat on other pages; edits persist across pages and setting changes
Press Save labels to CSV
serves_tasks: Open the saved subset as a grid of signal previews

features.name: Grid layout and keyboard paging
features.general: Set how many items per page and columns the review grid shows, and move between pages with buttons or keys
features.specific: Page columns (1–6) and Frames per page (1–15) dropdowns; 'Page x of y (a–b of n)' readout; Prev/Next buttons, arrow keys and PageUp/PageDown
steps: Choose Frames per page
Choose Page columns
Press Next/Prev or an arrow key / PageUp / PageDown to change page
serves_tasks: Change grid layout and page through items
